reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Brian Dennis
reviews.text: I can't say enough about the job Carmen and his crew completed at my property. From the initial meeting all the way through banging out the big job in less than a full day. The estimate was so good I stopped getting quotes once I saw it! They went above and beyond in every aspect. I won't hesitate to hire them again. The experience was so good we finally feel like we will be able to achieve our dream vision for our place and more come to fruition!

reviews.author: LaQuita Gilfillian
reviews.text: Eric and his team leader Carmen were excellent every step of the way. Carmen came out promptly on a Saturday! And gave me the estimate for the work, he identified a few issues that I did not know about. He gave a fair and honest estimate. Carmen and his team came out 2 days later and did a fantastic job!! Everything was done as discussed, their process with a little robotic stump grinder was very impressive and the clean-up was spotless!! A job very well done. I would give them 10 stars, highly recommend. Thank you

reviews.author: Jennifer McFarland
reviews.text: The absolute best tree service around. I called three other companies. The only one who answered the phone & came out within 2 hours. Very very good prices! His team was professional, quick, and best left my yard looking amazing. Will definitely recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Ray
reviews.text: Your DC company has DC been as professional and pleasant as anyone could expect. The 2 jobs we have had done have been spot on. They clean up as if they were not here. Pricing is better then what we expected and the hob was completed as we expected. We do not seeing use anyone else mmm in the future. Thank you !!

reviews.author: Michael McMichael
reviews.text: We had Aikens out over the weekend to remove one tree and trim some others. We are glad we chose them. Showed up on time and went over everything with me prior to starting to make sure he was performing the work just as we wanted. They took extra care not to damage my lawn and underground sprinkler system. Very professional, cleaned up perfectly before leaving. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Dennis Marchei Jr
reviews.text: Aiken tree service was phenomenal, they beat every quoted price and out performed the price their competitors were quoting. Had 2 very difficult trees to remove that were touching sheds and within 20 feet of 3 houses and they climbed and craned trees out and made it look easy, if you go with any other tree company you are making a mistake. I’d use them again in a heartbeat but have no trees remaining on my property because they removed them all!

reviews.author: Teeaira Small, MS
reviews.text: I filled out three request with three different companies and Aiken’s Tree Service was the one that called back promptly. I had someone out the next day providing a quote and two days later services began. The staff is friendly and they work fast! I feel like the price was right. I will definitely be using them in the near future!! Good customer service goes a long way! Keep up the good work Eric and Carmen!

reviews.author: Nimisha Patel
reviews.text: Erick, Carmen and the team were great! They are professional and friendly. They took their time and explained the process to both my husband and I. They even advised us on waiting to regrow grass which none of the other companies let us know. They arrived early and were quick to remove the tree and clean up the debris. The pricing was great, we will definitely be using them again!

reviews.author: Joseph Rodriguez
reviews.text: Carmen came and asked what I wanted done and set up the appointment. There was a cancellation and he called and asked if he was able to do the job on that time. I said of course and he showed up at the time he stated. After he and his team did what we wanted, he proceeded to take me around and showed me what was done to make sure everything we wanted was done. It was. The team made sure everything was cleaned up. It was all done quickly also. It was great hiring them.

reviews.author: Eleanor Bracey
reviews.text: We’ve used Aiken’s tree service twice now. Both times they were on time, did their work efficiently and thoroughly for a good price. They are polite and considerate. I would highly recommended Aiken’s tree service.

reviews.author: Richard Kelly
reviews.text: Carmen and Sean, along with their team provided professional single-day service in removing a number of eyesore cedar pine trees from my yard. Outstanding customer service, and I recommend them for your next tree job.

reviews.author: Pat Lombardo
reviews.text: Storm knocked a tree onto my house and cars. Aiken's showed up early next day and did a great job to carefully remove tree from the cars and house with no further damage. Great Job - Thanks!

reviews.author: Joanate Ratliff
reviews.text: This company was super professional. They came on time and worked super quickly. The price was fair. They did a great job managing the debris and when they were done they cleaned everything up.

reviews.author: Patty
reviews.text: The service was great and they did exactly what they said they would. Erik and Carmen were both personable , friendly and knowledgeable. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Jamison Maruca
reviews.text: On a Sunday afternoon at 2pm I was able to get an answer from the owner himself with in just a few rings. I explained what happened and that that tree had landed just above my daughters room. Within an hour a safety rope was in place. And first thing in the morning the very next day the tree was completely taken care of. They were quick professional and cleaned up everything. I didn’t even have to get up out of bed. Not to mention the price was very reasonable especially for an emergency job. Thank you so much! You truly saved the day!

reviews.author: Dorian Asllanaj
reviews.text: Carmen and Aiken’s crew removed nine trees from my property and did an amazing job. They were on time, professional, fast, and offered very competitive pricing. I’m extremely pleased with their service and would recommend Aiken’s to all my friends. Thank you again , for a job well done!! Alma Asllanaj

reviews.author: Connie Blardeblar
reviews.text: Wow, just wow. From meeting Carmen for an estimate to and through the date of service, Aiken's employees were kind and professional. The crew were like ants at a picnic, all over the place getting stuff done with total clean up ! I HIGHLY recommend Aiken's, it really felt like family.

reviews.author: steven loftis
reviews.text: Highly recommend Eric and his team !!!! They do great work yard looks amazing very professional they came right out and took care of everything

reviews.author: Kimberly R Leibovitz
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about my experience with this company so far. They have been extremely professional, on time, and have extremely fair rates. I am most impressed with Carmen, who was so pleasant to deal with, as he was very cheerful, hard-working, and eager to make sure that I was pleased with the work. They also cleaned up beautifully after all of the significant work, including grinding out, stumps, cutting back trees, removing extremely large bushes and much more. Do not hesitate to hire this company for all of your tree related needs. Their work is top notch!

reviews.author: Jonathan stewart
reviews.text: Did an absolutely phenomenal job. Crew showed up on time with no issues. Had me on the schedule and job completed in less than a week.

reviews.author: Debbie Markel
reviews.text: Arrived on time. Were very respectful of existing plants and grass. Cleaned up everything when finished. Worked with us while we added things to the job! Very nice to work with and reasonably priced. Very happy with this service!

reviews.author: Jena Alt
reviews.text: I just wanted to take a moment to share my recent experience with Aiken's Tree Service. Erick and his team are absolutely amazing, super professional and friendly! We had four huge trees taken down, and the process was quick and efficient. They also did a fantastic job cleaning up afterward. I highly recommend their services if you are ever in need of tree removal. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Kristen Moore
reviews.text: They did an amazing job! Worked with us to get everything done at a price we could afford. The crew was fast, efficient, and hardworking, and they went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. Highly recommend, and will be using again for future tree work!

reviews.author: Cesca Suon
reviews.text: Very professional. They were quick with all their responses and do what they say they will do. I was given an estimate on the same day I called. Within a short period of time I had my trees cut and stumps grinded. I’m very satisfied, will contact them for future tree trimmings.

reviews.author: Shani Lane
reviews.text: This Company came to our home and worked very hard. They didn't sit around and take breaks or prolong their service. They came to do a great job. We walked through our property several times to make sure we were on the same page of what we were wanting. After each section of our property they came to me to see if the service was to my satisfaction. Very professional and honest I had trees I was concerned with, Aikens gave me honest answers to our trees even informing me of trees on our property that were healing themselves..... Very knowledgeable of their craft.

reviews.author: Joseph Maurizio
reviews.text: I enjoyed the experience with Aiken’s. The price was below other estimates I received. The services were performed in a very timely manner and exceeded my expectations. I initially used Aiken’s to prune some tall trees surrounding my dwelling. The experience was so pleasant that I did not hesitate to reach back out to have a large stump removed from my property. Save your time and energy looking elsewhere and call Aiken’s for all your tree needs.

reviews.author: Sean Hansbury
reviews.text: Just another awesome job, took down 6 big trees in our front yard, and the cleanup they did afterwards was impressive, will definitely recommend them to do any type of tree service... thanks again for a great job..

reviews.author: Kathy T
reviews.text: Two very large trees removed. The crew was prompt, professional and took preventative measures to avoid damage to lawn between houses. Cleaned up perfectly too.

reviews.author: Alina
reviews.text: Aiken's Tree Service did an amazing job with both trimming and full tree removal, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the team was professional, punctual, and extremely efficient. They handled everything with great care, including trees close to our house, and left the yard spotless afterward. If you’re looking for a reliable, honest, and highly skilled tree service company, I strongly recommend Aiken’s Tree Service. We’ll definitely be using them again in the future. A big thanks to Carmen, Eric and their team for excellent work!

reviews.author: Tom Burmylo
reviews.text: These guy’s where in and out of my house in less than an hour start to finish quote was less than 3 others I received will definitely recommend these guys and will use there services again if need be Thank you Eric to you and your crew.

reviews.author: Kimberly Brock
reviews.text: The guys were totally awesome. They were hard working, courteous, respectful and left the yard in tip top shape. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Danielle Burns
reviews.text: They did a great job removing our dead tree next to the house and grinding it down. They also cut concerning branches off other trees hanging over our backyard and above our house. Erick/Carmen responded quickly to any inquiries and the price was very reasonable. I’m also very impressed with the clean up.

reviews.author: Kathy Lemon
reviews.text: Very pleased with our recent experience with Aiken's Tree Service. I made immediate contact with Eric and he was out within days to give me a quote and then complete the job. Did exactly what we asked for a fair price and cleaned up everything. We will definitely be using Aiken's again!

reviews.author: Shannon Finley
reviews.text: This company is amazing. After a heavy storm, I had a tree leaning on my house. Within 15 minutes of calling Erick, he had Carmen at my door to check it and schedule his team to come back within an hour. They did a great job, cleaned up everything, and were done so quickly. I really appreciated how responsive they were and will be recommending them to everyone. Thank you!

reviews.author: Constance Santandrea
reviews.text: Affordable, extremely professional! Keeps u informed of arrival date. Have used Aiken's for many yrs. Trust in Aikens Tree Service LLC

reviews.author: Vince Pappert
reviews.text: There's not much more I can say beyond all of these other 5 star reviews, but I can absolutely vouch for Erick and Aiken's Tree Service. Gave him a call looking for some tree maintenance advice and a path forward for a sickly looking maple. He was fast to respond and showed up a couple days later AFTER work hours to accommodate my schedule. I had quite a few inquiries and he was more than knowledgeable about all of them, but more importantly he didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need nor rush me to have anything done. Overall, Erick is just a great guy that loves what he does, is honest with your needs, and has the expertise to get the job done. 10/10

reviews.author: Nicole Boston
reviews.text: Erick and his team did a fantastic job on our home! They cleared out our backyard with complete professionalism and care. They arrived on time and completed the job in record time. I watched them for a little and was simply amazed at their expertise in taking down the trees. Very impressive. I highly recommend Erick and his crew for your tree service needs.

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.text: Excellent company. Was a difficult job & handled very professionally with the obstacles that were in place. Was a very large tree & one side had totally died. Grinded the very large stump also & so much room now in front of our tent. They don't service our area but graciously did so. Cleaned up completely. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Cathy R
reviews.text: Love you guys are the BEST! Communication is excellent, very reliable, knowledgeable, and very efficient! We used their service at our former home a couple times and will continue to rely on them at our new home. You did a great job and we love how our yard looks!

reviews.author: W Johnson
reviews.text: I’ve hired Aiken’s Tree Service for multiple jobs and have been consistently impressed by the outstanding results. They’re a truly professional company and exceptionally skilled at what they do. I highly recommend this company to anyone in need of reliable and expert tree services.

reviews.author: Concetta Alexander
reviews.text: They arrived early, removed 3 big trees that hung over my and cleaned up all the branches and everything as they said they would. The owner Erick is very nice and reasonably priced (as far as trees go). His crew was friendly and overall they did a great job. I will be using him again for another set of tree removals!

reviews.author: Kenneth Albert
reviews.text: Did everything we discussed, which was great because I had to be at work and couldn't be there. They were timely courteous professional. The price was great. They were flexible when I had to reschedule. They didn't penalize me for that. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Arthur Garcia
reviews.text: Excellent tree removal seevice following destruction by a tornado in Wenonah in September of 2021. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: MsPkramer
reviews.text: Excellent job done. Extremely professional and pleasant personality. Limbs removed, grinding stumps and excellent clean up. I would definitely recommend this company. One happy customer!

reviews.author: Alysa Mecke
reviews.text: This was our second time using Aikens and they really did such a great job. Carmen was a pleasure to work with and they cleaned up very well. Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Debra Zussman
reviews.text: From start to finish Erick was great to work with. Came out for estimate and was easy to talk to, listened to our needs, gave advice, and came in with a fair price. The days of tree cutting the crew was prompt and professional. Erick and Carmen were there to supervise and listened to our various specific requests. We had many trees removed and trimmed. I was paying a per day rate. When the work took longer than expected, I felt that Erick was fair in the pricing for the extra day. There was a separated day for stump grinding which also went well. Overall I was very satisfied with the company and the outcome.

reviews.author: David Flynn
reviews.text: I simply CANNOT say enough good things about the service I was given. My house was hit hard by the tornado a few days ago and they have already cleaned up the mess. The work was staggering but their crew worked hard - and I mean hard - to make sure I was taken care of. They took pride in their work and it shows. I would absolutely recommend them, and if I didn't lose all my trees to the storm I'm sure I would be using them again! Edited 7/28/23: after moving we used Aikens again for some tree trimming services and once again the service was outstanding. The crew delivered on everything they promised and did it at a great price. Before hand, Eric came out to assess the work and gave us several options and his recommendations with no pressure to make a sale. We were very pleased, another 5-star experience!

reviews.author: Dominique S
reviews.text: I had a few dead/dying trees and a big oak over the driveway that needed to go. I decided to call Aikens Tree Service because I saw all the top notch reviews on google. Erick was responsive and able to get out and give me a quote pretty quickly (I’ve had trouble getting estimates done by other companies in the past so this was a pleasant start). The crew came out today to do the tree removal and they were on time, fast and efficient. They cleaned the yard up great and didn’t forget anything we discussed (I’ve also had that issue with another tree service who didn’t remember the details of the job from the quote to the job despite having the notes/work order). Great job by Erick and his crew. 10/10 would definitely use them again if needed in the future!

reviews.author: Michele Carter
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal work. Here first thing in the morning and right to work nonstop all day! Took care of all my requests ( which were many) and a few additional issues I hadn’t noticed . All without missing a beat or extra money. No nickel and dime games with these guys. Wonderfully knowledgeable about all types of trees and shrubs and how best to handle each and every one. Came fully prepared and equipped with incredible machines to get the job done! Completely professional and just a joy to work with. I can’t say enough great things about this company and will highly recommend them to everyone I know. Many thanks to Aiken’s tree service for a job well done !

reviews.author: Pattie James
reviews.text: Responsive, timely, professional. They took the time to explain the process and made sure that we were satisfied with the job. I would 100% recommend Aiken Tree Servixe.

reviews.author: Mark Ellison
reviews.text: Quality of work far exceeded my expectations. Price quote was as good or better than the others I received and these guys didn’t leave a single branch or leaf on my property. Even swept up the dust and debris in the street in front of my house. You can’t even tell they were here. Thank you!

reviews.author: Joan Ambrosino
reviews.text: Carmen and the crew just removed four huge trees from my property….they did an excellent job, grounded stumps and clean up was great! You could tell they really take pride in their work and were very professional. I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Raymond Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Excellent work. On time, professional and personable. Fair price. Did not tear up lawn as another tree service did. Careful not to damage property. Raked ground to remove tread tracks. Replaced brick border that moved. Carmen and crew were the best. Will use them every time.

reviews.author: Matthew Spade
reviews.text: Excellent service. Reasonably priced. Owner Eric was great at communicating the process throughout the job. All debris was cleaned up and worked was performed on time. Use Aikens tree service. They are great.

reviews.author: Megan Browne
reviews.text: The crew arrived on time, quickly removed 2 trees from our property, and cleaned up the yard. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: danielle cat
reviews.text: Had Aiken's come out and do an estimate to cut down 20+ trees and shrubs. He showed up on time and gave me an estimate on the spot. The estimate was more then fair. They scheduled the work to be done with in a week of the estimate and all the work was completed in ONE day. Every member of the crew was professional and had great personalities. Answered any of our questions or concerns. Their work is meticulous and so was the clean up. Overall a fantastic experience. We could have not asked for a better result. I would and do highly recommend them to everyone. You will not find a better crew or a harder working crew. thank you for all your help guys !!

reviews.author: Joseph Omolo
reviews.text: Very friendly and knowledgeable team led by Erick. They came on time and did a splendid job. I would recommend Aiken's tree service to anyone who wants a wonderful job done and at a reasonable price!

reviews.author: Jennifer Hudson
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Aiken’s tree service. They were very reasonable, and on time when they said they would be at it house. I received a text message and an email advising me when they would arrive. They did a great job trimming up my tree, cleaned up my yard, raked up everything and did a fantastic job! I would highly recommend them and would use them again. They even emailed me a receipt after the work was done. Very professional.

reviews.author: Timothy King
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Erick and Aiken’s Tree Service. Erick was very professional, responsive, and both his communication and follow up were great. Erick and his team did an awesome job removing 3 solid oak trees from my property, this included tree stump removal, and debris haul away. I was impressed with how safe, efficient, and quick Erick and his team worked. Look no further for your tree removal needs. Contact Erick and Aiken’s Tree Service.

reviews.author: Gerald Moss
reviews.text: We needed a tree next to our driveway removed due to upheaval by its roots. The tree was gone in <10 minutes. Clean-up was fast and thorough. Aiken’s team was professional and friendly. Very satisfied with all aspects of our interaction.

reviews.author: James Hughes
reviews.text: These guys were prompt and professional. They cleaned up every perfectly. I received comments from my neighbors how impressed they were with Aiken's. Their price was reasonable. Even when I added and changed a job they were very polite and respectful. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Jackie Calvitti
reviews.text: We bought a home with tree roots into the septic field so we gad to have 4 tree taken down. They were all great to work with, they left the yard super clean, had great communication and at a great price. We’re glad that our realtor recommended them!

reviews.author: fin blue line
reviews.text: Needed four (4) large trees removed. Did my research, got multiple estimates, Aikens came in the lowest with the fastest availability. They arrived on time, and knocked out the job. They cleaned up, making my yard look better than when they arrived. Will definitely use again, and recommend. A+

reviews.author: Deanna Pisko
reviews.text: The guys at Aikens Tree were amazing. Showed up on time and worked quickly. They were very careful with our property and even let us know when something didn’t go as planned. It was so minor but the way they cared and went above and beyond in service was phenomenal. Extremely friendly professionals, even stopped to chat with our little one. Quick, efficient and thorough work. Will recommend and would use again in a heartbeat Thank you Aikens!

reviews.author: Dennis C
reviews.text: Aikens was very fairly priced and honest. The crew showed up early, did a fantastic job, and cleaned up before they left. Highly recommend and will use again in the figure.

reviews.author: Josh Sivel
reviews.text: Funny enough I flew a drone into a very tall tree and we needed a way to get it down. We called and had it down within the hour for a reasonable price and he did his best to get it down in one piece. Super friendly and great service! Thank you!

reviews.author: John Kennedy
reviews.text: They answered the phone, I appreciate that because most other companies didn't. They came out on time, some other companies didn't even show up. They gave me a good price, I had to throw 2 companies off the property because of insane pricing. We agreed on the price and they came back on time and did the work as promised. They had packed up all their stuff asked me if everything was OK, and I mentioned one branch should have been removed -without complaint they unpacked and spent another 20 minutes removing that 1 branch that needed to go. They really did a great job and I'm very appreciative. I can recommend them without hesitation. I'll be using them again.

reviews.author: Robert Weissinger
reviews.text: Awesome group of guys. They did a great job at a fair price. I would recommend them to anyone asking for tree Service. Erick kept me well informed and did a superb job Thanks again.

reviews.author: T- Con
reviews.text: Highly recommended by my neighbor who also used Aikins. Erick and his crew showed up on time and ready to go. They got right to work. I don't even think they took a break. The tree to be removed was 40 ft and in a delicate spot between my house and vinyl fence. They got it down with surgical precision, maintaining the integrity of my property. Aikens cleaned up nicely, actually leaving my yard better than before they arrived. Work was accomplished as agreed and at the price agreed upon. I will recommend Aikens and use their services in the future.

reviews.author: Anthony Russell
reviews.text: I had called to receive a estimate and Erick Aiken came out within the day or 2 to give me the estimate. Very nice guy! Gave me a great price and his men came did what was asked and Even though I told Eric that I had to work all weekend he allowed me to pay on sunday which is my day off. Not a lot of companies work like that especially if you are a first time customer. This is the company to use for any of your tree needs

reviews.author: Ace B
reviews.text: Eric came out next day for a quote. Gave me a phenomenal and honest price for 7 trees, cut, taken away and stump grind. He came when he said he would and him and the crew instantly got to work and blasted the whole job out in one day. not only are they quick, but efficient and professional. Would definitely recommend !

reviews.author: Janine Ekey
reviews.text: They had excellent communication from the first phone call till the work was completed. The crew came when they told me and finished within 3 hours. The work was done with precision and professionalism of a company with a 100 year history. Cleaned up everything.. Would definitely recommend them to everyone I know without hesitation.

reviews.author: Al Ball
reviews.text: Excellent service by true professionals. I highly recommend Carmen and Shaun for your tree, stump and shrub service! Great prices too!

reviews.author: Lorraine Brewer
reviews.text: Crew was very professional. They made sure we were happy with their work. They arrived on time and worked diligently. They were also ok with us watching the entire job. They cleaned our property and our neighbors property when the cutting was done. Very satisfied and very happy we chose this company for our job.

reviews.author: Alex R
reviews.text: Erick and his team are awesome. Very prompt in responding to calls/texts and completed the job in the specified time frame. They left the area very clean went above and beyond to make sure I was happy with the results. Thanks again!!!

reviews.author: Marc Ricci
reviews.text: Erick and his Crew at Aiken's Tree Service were the best experience I have had with a Tree removal company. He came out quickly for an estimate, put it in writing and lived up to that. Also, i didnt think there was any way he would have the job done in one day as it was a big job. They knocked it out in one day. To close it out his crew did an amazing job at the clean up, nothing left behind at all. I would recommedn Aiken's Tree Service to Everyone!

reviews.author: Revellid59 Revelli
reviews.text: Aiken's gave me a very good price. They came out dud the job quickly, safely and efficiently. I would definitely call them again for any other tree services and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Nick Coralluzzo
reviews.text: Erick and his team are the best around. If you want exceptional service for a fair price, look no further! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Robert Bernstein
reviews.text: We had a great experience dealing with akins tree service. The guys were all friendly and very skilled and professional. They did an excellent job and we are more than satisfied. We highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Elizannette Marrero
reviews.text: I just have them today come over and trim and raise two spruce trees and they did an excellent job, will definitely recommend to any person who needs trees service done! They left everything clean. Very responsible and punctual super nice people. Call them

reviews.author: Dominique SanGiovanni
reviews.text: Carmen and the crew did an excellent job removing 4 oak trees and trimming all the others in my front yard. They did stump removal, removed a dead branch, and removed a smaller tree in an inconvenient spot in the backyard. This is my second time using Aiken’s Tree Service and I couldn’t recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Ian Kaufman
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job for a great price! They went above and beyond what was in the contract and didn't charge me any extra. Also great with communication. Highly recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Brit Lodi
reviews.text: Had these guys come out to cut back some overhanging trees. Service was fast & very reasonably priced. We will definitely contact Aikens Tree Service for all future tree maintenance needs! Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Kathleen OBrien
reviews.text: This is the second time using Aiken’s Tree Service. Both times they went above and beyond. Carmen is great to work with. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.text: Aiken Tree Service was top notch. Arrived when they said they would, performed all of the services efficiently and thoroughly cleaned up. They cared about the service they provided and the customer. Thank you.

reviews.author: Cindy Oboyle
reviews.text: These guys did a great job. All workers were respectful and got the job done quickly. They did a great job cleaning up also. Would definitely recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Cheryl M. Adair
reviews.text: came out promptly for an estimate. Was timely on arrival for the service. Friendly, polite, professional. Left the area clean and the job perfect THANK YOU! Will recommend as well as hire again when needed

reviews.author: Cecille Bundy
reviews.text: I am very happy with the way the trees were trimmed and cut to ground level. I also appreciated the leaves being blown off the lawn and deck plus the fence rails put back in place. Thank you again for a job well done.

reviews.author: Josephine Keegan
reviews.text: Great bunch of guys! Worked hard and fast,would recommend them to anyone ! Thank you Aiken tree service.

reviews.author: Fletcher Duddy
reviews.text: Aiken's did a great job pruning trees in my backyard at a very reasonable price. I would definitely hire them again.

reviews.author: Brian Medley
reviews.text: I had three tall trees removed. They did an excellent job and cleaned up afterwards. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Kathleen OBrien
reviews.text: Excellent service. I highly recommend Aiken’s Tree Service. Carmen was very professional and easy to work with. I would definitely hire again.

reviews.author: Mary Rastelli
reviews.text: Arrived on time when they said they would. Fair price and they removed my dead tress. Very nice crew and they cleaned it up nicely. Can highly recommend

reviews.author: Alan Gorney
reviews.text: Very professional and cleaned up nicely. Hardly knew they were there… except for the missing tree. Great job and reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Elisa Winsor
reviews.text: Always a pleasure dealing with Erik, Carmen and crew. They are all very professional and do an excellent job of keeping you informed of their process. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mike Hammen
reviews.text: Carmen and his partner did a Great Job removing a Cherry Tree. They also removed the stump and clean up afterwards.. Highly recommend there services.

reviews.author: Joshua Teasdale
reviews.text: The entire crew was friendly and worked quickly and clean. I would highly recommend! Huge job and they made it look easy

reviews.author: Joe Matta
reviews.text: Timely and priced accordingly. Excellent job and quicker than I ever expected. Their services saved my back, I’m sure of that!

reviews.author: Terry Iwaniw
reviews.text: Basically, very satisfied with the service. The tree was removed quickly and the stump removed/ground down. However, I had requested another tree stump, located in the backyard, to be grinder/removed. It wasn’t.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Charlton
reviews.text: I would recommend Aiken's Tree Service to anyone. They were punctual, professional, knowledgeable, and very kind.

reviews.author: Gerrod Norman
reviews.text: Price was reasonable and the crew showed up on time and cleaned up the yard once finished with the tree trim.

reviews.author: Tim Wallace
reviews.text: The crew showed up right on time and took down the 2 trees in good time. Cleaned up the area. Good Job!!
